race.title: DBS And Willmott Dixon Building Together Handicap Chase
race.verdict: It's difficult to get away from GOLLY GOSH , who has taken well to chasing for his new yard and the front-running tactics that were successfully adopted last time often work well around here. Jac Jumper is potentially well handicapped on his best form, so he could emerge as the main threat if ready to go after a lengthy lay-off, with Largy Panic rounding off the shortlist. GOLLY GOSH (IRE) JAC JUMPER (FR) LARGY PANIC (IRE)
